memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks with a cane for knee pain, manages tailoring work seated.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal).
falls: No falls in last 12 months; gait slow but steady; TUG 13 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise heel‑cord stretching and supportive footwear.
medicines: 8 regular (paracetamol 650 mg SOS, topical diclofenac gel BD, calcium‑vit D3 OD, ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD, metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD) – polypharmacy, request Beers review.
mood: Reports occasional low mood, denies hopelessness.
carers: Daughter Priya, primary caregiver.
goal: "I want to keep stitching clothes without knee swelling and stay active with my grandchildren."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Able to stand 20 minutes, tailoring work limited by knee stiffness after morning.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw abnormal).
falls: One fall at home while reaching for shelf, no injury; gait antalgic; TUG 14 seconds – continue exercise, consider walking aid.
medicines: 8 regular – polypharmacy, note Beers review pending.
mood: Feels frustrated, tearful at times.
carers: Daughter Priya, primary caregiver.
goal: "I wish to walk to the market without pain and finish my tailoring orders on time."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin 9.8 g/dL (12-16); Serum ferritin 12 ng/mL (15-150); MCV 78 fL (80-100).
HbA1c 7.8% (4-5.6); Fasting plasma glucose 158 mg/dL (70-99).
Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 45 mg/g (<30).
Serum vitamin D 18 ng/mL (30-100).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD (increase from alternate days).
Metformin 500 mg BD (continue).
Glimepiride 1 mg OD (continue).
Empagliflozin 10 mg OD (continue).
Sitagliptin 100 mg OD (continue).
Paracetamol 650 mg SOS (continue).
Topical diclofenac gel BD (continue).
Calcium‑vit D3 OD (continue).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Standing tolerance 30 minutes, tailoring work improved after morning analgesia.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw abnormal).
falls: No new falls; gait mildly antalgic; TUG 13 seconds – continue strengthening.
medicines: 8 regular – polypharmacy, Beers review completed, no potentially inappropriate meds noted.
mood: Mood stable, reports occasional sadness.
carers: Daughter Priya, primary caregiver.
goal: "I want to reduce knee swelling so I can sew for longer periods without breaks."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dilated fundus exam: Mild microaneurysms in both eyes, no macular edema, vision 6/9 each eye. Recommend annual repeat.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to Orthopaedic Surgery, Dr S. Reddy, for evaluation of bilateral knee osteoarthritis and possible intra‑articular injection.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Orthopaedic review: X‑ray shows medial compartment joint space narrowing. Recommended intra‑articular hyaluronic acid injection series; physiotherapy referral made.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Message via clinic app: "My knees feel stiff after sitting, and I noticed bruising near the inner knee after the injection. Is this normal?"?

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Able to walk 15 minutes without cane, tailoring work less painful after injection.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal).
falls: No falls; gait improved; TUG 11 seconds – within normal range, continue balance exercises.
medicines: 8 regular – polypharmacy, advise continue current regimen, monitor for hypoglycemia.
mood: Reports improved spirits, enjoys time with grandchildren.
carers: Daughter Priya, primary caregiver.
goal: "I want to walk to the temple without pain and attend my granddaughter’s school event."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Empagliflozin 10 mg OD (stopped due to borderline vitamin D and mild volume depletion).
Metformin 500 mg BD (continue).
Glimepiride 1 mg OD (continue).
Sitagliptin 100 mg OD (continue).
Paracetamol 650 mg SOS (continue).
Topical diclofenac gel BD (continue).
Calcium‑vit D3 OD (continue).
Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD (continue).

memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-08-12 10:30 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) for routine follow‑up.
